# Entre Trámites

> Online advisory platform specializing in Spanish bureaucracy, immigration, visas, taxes, and business management for expats and entrepreneurs.

Entre Trámites provides comprehensive legal and administrative consulting services for foreigners navigating Spanish residency, work visas, business formation, and tax compliance. The platform combines immigration expertise with corporate advisory services, serving digital nomads, students, entrepreneurs, and multinational companies relocating to Spain.

## Key Topics

- Spanish Residency (NIE, TIE, CUE)
- Immigration Services & Visa Applications
- Work Visas (Employee, Self-employed, Entrepreneur)
- Digital Nomad Visa
- Student Visa
- Spanish Nationality by Residency
- Global Mobility & Relocation
- Company Formation & Registration
- Self-employed (Autónomos) Advisory
- SME (PYME) Management
- Labor & Payroll Services
- Tax Optimization & Compliance
- Sworn Translation Services
- EU Community Card
- Criminal Records Documentation

## Immigration & Residency Services

- [Obtain Spanish Residency Easily](https://entretramites.com/extranjeria/vivir-en-espana): Spanish residency documentation: NIE, TIE, CUE registration services
- [Digital Nomad Visa Consultation](https://entretramites.com/consulta-visa-de-nomada-digital): Free consultation booking for Spanish Digital Nomad Visa requirements
- [Student Visa in Spain](https://entretramites.com/extranjeria/estudiar-en-espana): Student visa and residency permit advisory for Spain study programs
- [Highly Qualified Professional Visa](https://entretramites.com/extranjeria/visa-profesional-cualificado): Highly Qualified Professional visa residency advisory and application
- [Employee Work Residency Visa](https://entretramites.com/extranjeria/visa-trabajo-cuenta-ajena): Employee work residency visa advisory for Spain employment
- [Self-employed Work Residency Visa](https://entretramites.com/extranjeria/visa-trabajo-cuenta-propia): Self-employed work residency visa advisory for Spain entrepreneurs
- [Entrepreneur Residency Visa - ENISA](https://entretramites.com/extranjeria/visa-emprendedor-enisa): Entrepreneur residency visa with ENISA report for Spanish startups
- [Spanish Nationality by Residency](https://entretramites.com/extranjeria/nacionalidad-por-residencia): Guide to obtaining Spanish nationality through residency requirements
- [EU Community Card](https://entretramites.com/extranjeria/tarjeta-comunitaria): EU community card guide for family members of EU citizens
- [Immigration Specialist Consultation](https://entretramites.com/asesoria/consulta-especialista-extranjeria): Online immigration specialist consultation for visas and residency

## Business & Corporate Services

- [ET Corporate - Business Expansion](https://entretramites.com/mercantil): ET Corporate: Business expansion, payroll, taxes, company setup Spain
- [Company Formation in Spain](https://entretramites.com/mercantil/constitucion-de-empresa): Company formation advisory: Limited Liability Company registration Spain
- [Self-employed (Autónomos) Advisory](https://entretramites.com/asesoria-autonomos): Self-employed advisory: accounting, taxes, IVA, business management
- [SME (PYME) Advisory](https://entretramites.com/asesoria-pymes): SME advisory: tax management, accounting, corporate taxes Spain
- [Labor & Payroll Management](https://entretramites.com/asesoria-laboral): Labor advisory: payroll management, Social Security, employment

## Global Mobility & Relocation

## Legal Documentation & Support Services
